entities.name: Mabel
entities.description: A mousefolk baker and swordfighter from Goodhill, main character of the Bloomburrow storyline.

entities.name: Cragflame
entities.description: Magical sword Mabel inherited from her mother Iris.

entities.name: Lily Emberseed
entities.description: Legendary hero from whom Mabel descends.

entities.name: Order of the Holly Leaf
entities.description: Storied group of soldiers of which Mabel is a scion.

entities.name: Helga
entities.description: Frogfolk augur who warns Mabel of the Calamity Beasts.

entities.name: King Glarb
entities.description: Augur of Fountainport who stole Maha's egg.

entities.name: Cruelclaw
entities.description: Mercenary who brought Glarb the egg.

entities.name: Maha
entities.description: Great Night Owl whose egg was stolen.

entities.name: Echoverse Mabel
entities.description: Alternate Echoverse version of Mabel whose village was destroyed, who wields the cursed staff Cragbane and seeks revenge on Glarb.

entities.name: Cragbane
entities.description: Cursed staff that drains and stores the power of the Calamities.

events.summary: Mabel joins the mousefolk defenders and drives off bandits attacking Goodhill.
events.quote: She joined the local band of mousefolk defenders when bandits attacked Goodhill, protecting the town and driving off the outlaws.

events.summary: Helga warns Mabel of the coming Calamity Beasts; Mabel takes up Cragflame and heads to Pondside with companions.
events.quote: she answered the call to adventure.

events.summary: Ral Zarek joins the party in Three Trees City, and they decide to consult King Glarb in Fountainport.
events.quote: Later in Three Trees City , Ral Zarek joined her party.

events.summary: Glarb reveals he stole Maha's egg to tame a Calamity and sends Cruelclaw against Mabel's party.
events.quote: the king revealed that he was the one responsible for the Calamities' rampage

events.summary: Maha appears and Mabel soothes it by returning its egg, saving the plane.
events.quote: Mabel soothed the beast's wrath by returning its egg, saving the plane from the wrath of the Calamities.

events.summary: Mabel reunites with her family and gives Ral ironsap buttons before he planeswalks away.
events.quote: At the end of her journey, she reunited with her loving family.

events.summary: In the Echoverse, the Calamity Beasts destroy Mabel's village and she vows revenge on Glarb.
events.quote: In the Echoverse , her village was destroyed by the Calamity Beasts, separating her family.

relations.quote: lives in the village of Goodhill with her husband Clem

relations.note: mother, from whom she inherited Cragflame
relations.quote: Mabel inherited Cragflame from her mother, Iris.
She is descended from the legendary hero Lily Emberseed .
the king revealed that he was the one responsible for the Calamities' rampage
Blaming King Glarb , she vowed revenge against him.
